title: Expanded colors

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Extend a palette through related light and dark variants so variety retains a visible family relationship.
strategic_value: Parallel hue families can broaden Instagram’s expressive range while keeping it coherent.
demonstration: Five light hues form the upper row and five dark hues form the lower row, with names and hex labels.
practical_value: Select an extended shade by its relationship to a core hue rather than introducing an unrelated color.

content_islands.name: Light variants
content_islands.spec: Place the five light hue swatches in one aligned row.

content_islands.name: Dark variants
content_islands.spec: Align the dark equivalents underneath and preserve each reproduction label.

reference_purposes.Expression: The paired light and dark rows demonstrate an extended family of colors.
reference_purposes.Application: Named, coded variants provide additional color choices for the system.
